name.en: Deep Forest of the Winter Raven
name.ja: <ruby>白<rt>はく</rt></ruby><ruby>鴉<rt>あ</rt></ruby>の<ruby>深<rt>ふか</rt></ruby>き<ruby>森<rt>もり</rt></ruby>

text.en: When this card is activated: You can add 1 "Winter Raven" monster from your Deck to your hand. "Winter Raven" Monster Cards you control cannot be destroyed by card effects. During your End Phase: You can Set 1 "Winter Raven" Trap from your Deck or GY. You can only use this effect of "Deep Forest of the Winter Raven" once per turn. You can only activate 1 "Deep Forest of the Winter Raven" per turn.
text.zh-CN: 此卡名的卡1回合仅可发动1张，此卡名的③效果1回合仅可使用1次。①：作为此卡发动时的效果处理，可从牌组将1只“白鸦”怪兽加入手牌。②：只要此卡存在于场地区域，自己场上的“白鸦”怪兽卡不会因效果被破坏。③：在自己的结束阶段可以发动。从自己牌组・墓地将1张“白鸦”陷阱卡放置在自己场上。
